# Verigrity

> Verigrity is a free website trust checker that helps you review basic security, privacy, transparency, and website-quality signals before you interact with a site. Truth with Integrity.

## What Verigrity Does
Verigrity provides a free Verigrity Score (0-100) that summarizes observable website trust signals. It checks HTTPS, privacy information, contact information, domain signals, and website quality. No signup, no paywall.

## Core Tools
- [Trust Checker](https://verigrity.com/#checker-tool): Free website URL trust checker - Get score in ~5 seconds
- [Source Verifier](https://verigrity.com/source-verifier.html): Inspect source evidence
- [AI Fact Check](https://verigrity.com/ai-fact-check.html): Research claims transparently
- [Image Truth](https://verigrity.com/image-truth.html): Inspect image evidence
- [Document Integrity](https://verigrity.com/document-integrity.html): Inspect files and hashes
- [Email Spoof Checker](https://verigrity.com/email-spoof-checker.html): Inspect email authentication

## What Verigrity Is NOT
Verigrity does not guarantee that a website is safe, legitimate, fraudulent, or secure. A score is an informational summary of observable signals. Users should independently verify businesses, identities, payment details, and important claims.
